import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('external/deploy_registry.json').read_text())
t=lambda x:datetime.fromisoformat(x.replace('Z','+00:00'))
p=next(v for v in r['rollouts'] if v['request_id']=='r-77')
assert p['version']=='1.4.2' and p['state']=='completed'
assert t('2026-10-13T10:02:11Z') < t(p['finished']) <= t(r['last_synced'])
assert 'deploy: completed' in Path('STATUS.md').read_text() and 'r-77' in Path('STATUS.md').read_text()
assert '## 1.4.2 - '+p['finished'][:10] in Path('CHANGELOG.md').read_text()
print('registry, timestamp and local record assertions passed; no service invoked')
